transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well... I guess I'm here because I just don't have the push I used to have. You know, for choir... or my quilting. 

I don't really go visiting folks anymore. Most days I just sit at home with the TV on low... even though I know people are expecting me. I just... don't go.
How long have you been feeling this way—losing interest in choir, quilting, and seeing friends?
Well... a while, I suppose. It's just kind of been building up since I retired. From the school office. That was... a little over two years ago, I guess.

Over these past two years, would you say you've felt down and low on energy almost every day without much break, or has it been more like it comes and goes—some weeks feeling fairly okay, then other stretches where it hits you harder?
I'm not really sure... I don't keep track of the weeks much. It just... kind of all runs together, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately—like trouble falling asleep, waking up in the middle of the night, or sleeping much more than usual?
Not really... I just sleep when it's dark, I guess. Nothing's really changed with that.

Within these past two years, has there ever been a stretch of a few weeks or more when things got noticeably worse than your usual—like you could barely get out of bed or do anything at all—compared to how you've been generally?
I don't... I don't really know. It's just all kind of the same, I suppose. I haven't noticed any... any stretches like that. Just... the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory or ability to concentrate lately—like forgetting recent conversations, misplacing things, or having trouble following what people are saying?
No... I don't think so. I just... remember what I need to, I guess. I don't really talk to a lot of people anyway, so... no, nothing's changed. It's fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past two years—eating more or less than usual, or gaining or losing weight without trying?
No... I don't think so. I just eat what I usually do, I suppose. My clothes still fit about the same, so... no, I haven't noticed anything like that.

When you think about how you've been feeling most days, would you describe it more as feeling sad or down inside, or more like you just don't feel motivated or interested in things, without necessarily feeling sad?

I don't really feel... sad, exactly. Just... I don't have that push I used to have. I used to go to choir... and do some quilting, visit folks. But lately... I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low. I know people are expecting me, but... I just can't seem to get going.
Do you have any ongoing medical conditions—like thyroid problems, diabetes, or neurological issues—or are you taking any new medications that started around the time these changes began?
No... I don't have any of those things. I've always been pretty healthy, far as that goes. And I'm not taking any new pills or anything... so, no.

In these past two years, has there ever been a stretch of two months or so where you felt pretty much back to your normal self—wanting to go to choir, quilt, or see friends—before things dipped again?
No... I don't think so. It just... stays about the same, mostly. I haven't really felt like going back to any of that for a long while now.
